checklist.title: Delete or reset your advertising ID
checklist.text: Settings → Privacy → Ads → Delete advertising ID (or Reset advertising ID). On some phones: Settings → Google → All services → Privacy & security → Ads. Labels vary by Android version and phone maker; search Settings for Ads. This does not stop all tracking.

checklist.title: Turn off Timeline (formerly Location History)
checklist.text: Google Account → Data & privacy → History settings → Timeline → Turn off. Delete existing visits separately in Google Maps → your profile → Your Timeline. Review every eligible device and any Timeline backup. Turning it off does not delete old data or stop other activity settings from saving location.

checklist.title: Limit app location access
checklist.text: Settings → Apps → choose an app → Permissions → Location → Allow only while using the app, Ask every time, or Don't allow. Turn off Use precise location when approximate is enough. Location-based features may work less well.

checklist.title: Review app permissions
checklist.text: Settings → Security & privacy → Privacy → Permission manager. Review camera, microphone, contacts, SMS and nearby devices; remove access apps do not need. Or use Settings → Apps → choose an app → Permissions. Enable Pause app activity if unused where available.

checklist.title: Turn off Wi-Fi and Bluetooth scanning
checklist.text: Settings → Location → Location services → Wi-Fi scanning and Bluetooth scanning → off. On older Android, scanning may be directly under Location. This can reduce location accuracy without turning off Wi-Fi or Bluetooth itself.

checklist.title: Review Chrome privacy settings
checklist.text: Chrome → ⋮ → Settings → Privacy and security. Review third-party cookies and Ad privacy (where available); disable ad topics, site-suggested ads and ad measurement if offered. Keep Safe Browsing protection on. Incognito does not make you anonymous to sites or your network.

checklist.title: Review Google Web & App Activity
checklist.text: Settings → Google → Manage your Google Account → Data & privacy → History settings → Web & App Activity → Turn off, or Turn off and delete activity. Review the Chrome history and voice/audio options too. Google is rolling out separate Search services settings, so also review those if shown. Labels may differ during this rollout.
